items.name: dsh-skill-intelligence
items.desc: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.

items.name: dsh-skillopt
items.desc: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).

items.name: dsh-token-caveman
items.desc: Terse prose for DeepSeek Harness — compress the agent's own output so every reply costs fewer tokens (layer 4). Style, never substance.

items.name: dsh-token-handoff
items.desc: Session context handoff for DeepSeek Harness — stop re-reading and re-deriving context every session. A single skill (layer ①) that keeps the next session warm.

items.name: dsh-token-headroom
items.desc: Context compaction / headroom for DeepSeek Harness — compress the live context so the prompt stays small without losing the state that matters (layer 3).

items.name: dsh-token-rtk
items.desc: Input redundancy pruning for DeepSeek Harness — drop repeated/redundant tokens before they reach the model (layer ②).

items.name: dsh-token-skills
items.desc: Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.

items.name: dsh-invest-bundle
items.desc: Investment research bundle: 10 tools (search, page fetch, source audit, claim verification, numeric rigor, channel health, workflow loader, chart engine, PDF renderer, PDF gate) and 23 skills adapted from ai-berkshire. Runs a six-phase workflow where four parallel agents (Duan Yongping, Buffett, Munger, Li Lu) research a company, cross-examine each other, and ship a chart-rich PDF with cover, tables, captions and page numbers. Requires Python 3.10+; the chart and PDF tools also need python-docx and matplotlib.

items.name: dsh-skill-select
items.desc: Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.

items.name: dsh-amphoreus
items.desc: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.

items.name: dsh-skills-nexus
items.desc: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.

items.name: dsh-learn
items.desc: Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single validated writer `learn_skill_manage`. An idle curator marks unused skills stale and archives them by moving rather than deleting, and spares any skill that is still being loaded. Five tools: `learn`, `learn_review`, `learn_curator`, `learn_skill_manage`, `learn_skills`. Registers a prompt section stating the criteria, and a tool guard that refuses direct edits to skill files so the writer cannot be bypassed.

items.name: learning-skills
items.desc: Provides three learning skills for course notes, conceptual explanations, and self-contained lecture chapters, with bundled references and course helper scripts.

items.name: dsh-gui-handoff
items.desc: Hand a command-line-verified operation over to the GUI: drive it once, verify with ground truth, and hand back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.

items.name: dsh-plugin-zerone
items.desc: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.

items.name: dsh-knj-extension-center
items.desc: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.

items.name: dsh-skill-manager
items.desc: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.

items.name: yinchao-ai-music-skill
items.desc: Generate complete AI songs and BGM from prompts or lyrics, with reference-audio creation and song extension.

items.name: dsh-creative-studio
items.desc: Image and video production toolkit for DeepSeek Harness - background removal with quality tiers, local inpainting retouch, headline and logo compositing, batch platform-size exports and image QA reports; for video, AI subject matting with background replacement (RVM ONNX, plus a chroma-key path), animated titles with fade/slide/typewriter/karaoke presets, 53 transitions with stylized variants, and light-effect and grading presets with LUT support, alongside footage inventory, accurate cutting, subtitle burn-in, music mixing and platform-spec exports; it provisions its own local Python runtime through a bundled bootstrap script.

items.name: dsh-video-to-notes
items.desc: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.

items.name: dsh-skill-starter
items.desc: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.

items.name: dsh-i-have-adhd
items.desc: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.

items.name: dsh-skill-status
items.desc: It shows the number of confirmed loaded skills in the conversation header. Click **技能** (Skills) to open the right sidebar and check whether each skill's full main body remains in the current main assistant context, along with its recorded versions and sources.

items.name: lelogin-skill
items.desc: Provide a LeLogin skill for credential injection and authenticated business applications without exposing plaintext secrets.

items.name: skill-injector-plugin
items.desc: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.

items.name: dsh-session-lab
items.desc: DSH session workflows for packaging verifiable capsules, evaluating reusable Skills, and comparing controlled session trajectories.

items.name: dsh-fix-duplicate-loader-id
items.desc: Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).

items.name: dsh-skill-studio
items.desc: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.

items.name: project-cross-migration
items.desc: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-skill-explorer
items.desc: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.

items.name: dsh-skill-router
items.desc: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.

items.name: dsh-opengis-skill
items.desc: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.
